summary: Acquires a mutex (this+0xD4) with timeout this+0xD8, reads an accumulated timer double via FloatAdditionReturnsFUN00568d90Param1 (0x00583680) with a NULL timer object when the wait is blocked, releases the mutex, and returns the timer value. Thread-safe timer read.

operations.description: Mutex handle at this+0xD4 must be non-NULL before waiting; otherwise timer object passed as NULL.
WaitForSingleObject(mutexHandle, this+0xD8 timeout); proceed when return is 0 (WAIT_OBJECT_0) or 128 (WAIT_ABANDONED), else blocked and timer object is NULL.
Read accumulated timer double via FloatAdditionReturnsFUN00568d90Param1 (0x00583680); a NULL parameter reads 0.
ReleaseMutex(mutexHandle at this+0xD4) when the handle is non-NULL.
Return the timer double read under the mutex.
